assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original production pixel-art asset for a Chinese middle-school science exploration platform set in 2057, art direction 'Clear Sky Observatory'. Cohesive 16-bit-inspired hand-placed pixel style, unmistakable crisp square pixel clusters, logical pixel grid about 4 output pixels, integer stair-step silhouettes, no antialiasing or blur, flat color clusters with 2-3 shade steps, restrained 24-color palette. Palette deep navy #102D40 outlines, steel blue #1C4355, sky cyan #BBDDED and #75BCD9, warm ivory #FFF9E9, teal #087F78, mint #BCEADB, foliage #468C62, rocks #567888, tiny warm gold #F3C76B details. Three-quarter orthographic view, sunlight from upper left, friendly science expedition rather than farming. No letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermark, UI, borders, buttons, or humans. This must be standalone original art, never copying a known game, artist, character or reference scene. Asset type: wide landscape header environment, horizontal 3:1 composition. Bright calm blue sky, layered crisp white cloud banks, a distant pale ringed planet; on the RIGHT two floating grassy rocky islands, a modest ivory and teal future observatory with small antenna and solar wing, plants, a narrow turquoise waterfall to the cloud sea. Left 45 percent deliberately uncluttered mostly pale sky and distant clouds as a crop-safe quiet zone; all recognizable structures within the central-right 55 percent. Large readable pixel shapes, not densely packed texture. No foreground frame. Enough vertical sky margin for cropping to a 180px tall webpage header.
